title: Il serpente
scene: Franco-Italian Cold War spy thriller; 1970s experimental film music
notes: Tense musique concrète alternates with psychedelic jazz, organ-driven grooves and wistful wordless singing.

title: Sepolta viva
scene: Italian period melodrama; romantic orchestral film music
notes: Elegiac strings, solo piano and harp sustain intimate melancholy beside one Latin a cappella cue.

title: Giordano Bruno
scene: Italian historical and philosophical cinema; modernist sacred scoring
notes: Latin polyphony confronts austere modernist sonorities, English horn lament and ominous percussion.

title: Il sorriso del grande tentatore
scene: Italian religious psychological horror; experimental liturgical film score
notes: Aggressive Latin choral sequences mingle devotional gravity with dissonance and unexpected rhythmic passages.
